description: Defines data structures for configuring bandwidth parts (BWP) in a 5G NR scheduler, including parameters for PDSCH, PUCCH, PUSCH, RACH, paging, and radio link monitoring.

classes.name: pdsch_builder_params
classes.description: Configuration parameters for PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) in a BWP.

classes.name: pucch_builder_params
classes.description: Configuration parameters for PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) in a BWP.

classes.name: pusch_builder_params
classes.description: Configuration parameters for PUSCH (Physical Uplink Shared Channel) in a BWP.

classes.name: rach_builder_params
classes.description: Parameters for Random Access procedures in a BWP.

classes.name: paging_builder_params
classes.description: Parameters for paging configuration in a BWP.

classes.name: du_rlm_params
classes.description: Parameters for Radio-Link Monitoring setup in a BWP.

classes.name: bwp_builder_params
classes.description: Aggregate configuration for a bandwidth part, including PDSCH, PUSCH, PUCCH, CSI, SRS, RACH, paging, and RLM.
